sentences.text: Keris pusaka milik keluarga Agus pernah menjadi barang sengketa di pengadilan ini.
sentences.en: The heirloom kris of Agus's family was once the object of a dispute in this court.
sentences.ko: 아구스 집안의 가보 크리스 단검이 이 법원에서 다툼의 대상이 된 적이 있어요.

sentences.text: Wajan besi tua di dapur itu adalah barang pusaka dari nenek Wati.
sentences.en: The old iron wok in the kitchen is an heirloom from Wati's grandmother.
sentences.ko: 부엌의 낡은 무쇠 웍은 와티 할머니에게서 물려받은 가보예요.

sentences.text: Buku sejarah yang dikutip jaksa menceritakan penindasan petani oleh tuan tanah.
sentences.en: The history book the prosecutor quoted describes the oppression of farmers by landlords.
sentences.ko: 검사가 인용한 역사책은 지주들의 농민 억압을 다뤄요.

sentences.text: Film yang diputar di televisi restoran bercerita tentang penindasan rakyat kecil pada masa lalu.
sentences.en: The film playing on the restaurant TV is about the oppression of ordinary people in the past.
sentences.ko: 식당 텔레비전에서 나오는 영화는 옛날 서민들이 억압받던 이야기예요.

sentences.text: Bendahara koperasi itu diadili karena penggelapan uang anggota.
sentences.en: The cooperative's treasurer was put on trial for embezzling members' money.
sentences.ko: 그 협동조합 회계 담당자는 조합원 돈을 횡령해 재판을 받았어요.

sentences.text: Wati memecat kasir yang ketahuan melakukan penggelapan uang hasil penjualan.
sentences.en: Wati fired the cashier who was caught embezzling sales money.
sentences.ko: 와티는 매상 돈을 빼돌리다 들킨 계산원을 해고했어요.

sentences.text: Rekaman kamera jalan menjadi bukti utama dalam kasus pemukulan sopir angkot.
sentences.en: Street camera footage became the main evidence in the case of the minibus driver's beating.
sentences.ko: 거리 카메라 영상이 미니버스 기사 폭행 사건의 핵심 증거가 됐어요.

sentences.text: Para tamu terkejut melihat berita pemukulan wasit di televisi restoran.
sentences.en: The guests were shocked to see news of a referee being beaten on the restaurant TV.
sentences.ko: 손님들은 식당 텔레비전에서 심판 폭행 소식을 보고 놀랐어요.

sentences.text: Agus melihat tren baru di kalangan pengacara muda yang memakai tablet di ruang sidang.
sentences.en: Agus noticed a new trend among young lawyers using tablets in the courtroom.
sentences.ko: 아구스는 젊은 변호사들이 법정에서 태블릿을 쓰는 새 유행을 봤어요.

sentences.text: Wati mengikuti tren minuman boba supaya pelanggan muda mau datang.
sentences.en: Wati followed the boba drink trend so young customers would come.
sentences.ko: 와티는 젊은 손님들이 오도록 버블티 유행을 따라갔어요.

sentences.text: Perkara itu bermula dari bola yang memecahkan jendela tetangga, bukan masuk ke gawang.
sentences.en: The case began with a ball that broke a neighbor's window instead of going into the goal.
sentences.ko: 그 사건은 골대 대신 이웃집 창문으로 날아간 공에서 시작됐어요.

sentences.text: Para tamu bersorak ketika bola masuk ke gawang dalam siaran sepak bola di layar besar.
sentences.en: The guests cheered when the ball went into the goal in the football broadcast on the big screen.
sentences.ko: 큰 화면 축구 중계에서 공이 골대에 들어가자 손님들이 환호했어요.
